subject: Png graphs too large when increasing dpi to 700

messages.author: b53d7ee73930a901
messages.subject: Png graphs too large when increasing dpi to 700
parts:
Dear list,

I am starting with knitr, RStudio and Markdown, and it seems to be an
exiting workflow for reproducible data analysis (so thanks for knitr
Yihui). When trying to export from markdown to html, however, I can't
get the right size for the graphs if I increase dpi from the default
72 to 700. The graph is huge, albeit defining a smaller size with
fig.width and fig.height arguments. Do you get the same result when
running (Knit HTML) the code below? My R session is at the bottom of
the page.

Best regards,

Alan

Title
========================================================

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax
for authoring web pages (click the **MD** toolbar button for help on
Markdown).

When you click the **Knit HTML** button a web page will be generated
that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R
code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like
this:

```{r}
summary(cars)
```

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r dpi=700, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
plot(cars)
```

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Png graphs too large when increasing dpi to 700
parts:
That is expected. 7inch * 700dpi = 4900pixels. There is no way to
specify the figure size in markdown syntax ![](), but since you
brought this issue up, I think I have got a solution. Please file this
issue to https://github.com/yihui/knitr/issues if you can. Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: 0dd6c9694b3c4809
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Png graphs too large when increasing dpi to 700
parts:
The Discount extension to markdown supports size

![Marked logo](http://markedapp.com/favicon.png =100x100)

But markdown itself is totally happy with embedded html.
Perhaps images should be

<img src="http://markedapp.com/favicon.png" width=100>

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Png graphs too large when increasing dpi to 700
parts:
In the development version, you can set, for example,
out.width='500px' so that the width of the plot will be 500px. This
gives you control of the figure size in markdown.

Regards,
